name: Testimonial quotes reference
description: A quote can credit a person with a title and a face: quote.role and quote.photo (FA-12). One slide each for a testimonial with a headshot, a role without a photo, a long testimonial, and the plain attribution-and-source quote, which is unchanged. See docs/content-payloads.md.

quote.text: We would rather spend a week on capacity than a month on an outage, and this is the first tool that made that trade visible.
Exceptions became visible before they turned into escalations.
Before the rollout our reviews took three meetings and a spreadsheet nobody trusted. Now the owner, the numbers and the open questions are on one page, and the review ends when the page does.
